name: Onna Darake no Isekai ni Shoukan Sareta Hi
original_name: 女だらけの異世界に召喚された日
source:
The main character Shizuki Nakata is suddenly transported into an alternate world.
The world is called Eurupe, and only women exist in it.
With all the males gone, there is a "sacred fountain" that is used, where women bathe and gradually become pregnant.
Having never experienced intercourse, the women of Eurupe are startled at seeing a male genital.
As if possessed by a higher power, the women begin to move their hips with tears in their eyes.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE244202.html]DLsite English[/url]]

男性全部消失后，这里有一座“圣泉”，女性会在其中沐浴并逐渐怀孕。
尤鲁佩的女性从未经历过性交，看见男性生殖器时惊慌失措。
仿佛被更高存在附身，她们含泪扭动腰肢。
